info.name: QuizMaker — Local Docker
info.description:
Local Docker HTTP tests. 00 Smoke is read-only. 10 Auth creates a unique account per run. 11 Access uses the local, unshared accessFixtureData environment value for existing reader, author and admin permission checks; no iteration data file is required. External providers stay offline. Prepare fixtures with ./tools/local-api.sh fixtures. Keep shared values and checked-in exports free of credentials.
20 Quizzes and attempts: repeatable private quiz CRUD with five prepared local questions and guarded cleanup.
21 Quiz revision publication: OpenAPI-first feature #935 publication, replay and conflict checks. One explicit setup contract assertion currently fails because POST /quizzes documents 200 but returns 201.
21 now also covers publication validation boundaries and access denial for the prepared reader, with owner publication as a positive control.
22 Publication ownership: author B denial, cross-owner administrator publication and authority revalidation on replay, using only temporary quizzes and prepared local users. Folder 22 also checks ROLE_MODERATOR publication and exact replay with QUIZ_MODERATE on the temporary A-owned private quiz. Folder 22 groups complete independent quiz-ownership and question-source-ownership scenarios in one level of child folders.

item.description: OpenAPI-first coverage for completed feature #935 (merged PR #937, 1eb446d6). Sources: local /api/v1/api-summary and /v3/api-docs/{quizzes,questions,auth}; operationId publishQuizRevision. Tests first publication, exact replay, input/auth errors, stale counter, changed command reuse, new publication and old replay after it. Uses existing local unshared accessFixtureData, a new private draft per run and five prepared questions. Run all 41 requests in order, without iteration data, persisted responses, logs, saved cookies or kept variables; disable Stop run if an error occurs so cleanup can run. Known contract mismatch: POST /quizzes returns 201 while current OpenAPI documents only 200. A separate failing assertion reports this mismatch and the valid draft is used to complete publication checks. Cleanup deletes only this run draft and preserves fixtures and normal retained publication history. Draft question IDs and immutable question revision IDs are distinct namespaces; OpenAPI does not promise cross-publication question revision ID reuse. Additional OpenAPI-first coverage: invalid bearer, prepared reader denial, malformed JSON/path UUID, negative counter, empty/duplicate order, unsupported Content-Type and unavailable quiz. Both author and reader sessions are explicitly closed. All denials precede the first owner publication; counter one is the positive control that no rejected command published a revision. Duplicate-order status accepts the documented 400/422 categories because Swagger has no duplicate-specific mapping. Contract status mismatches stay failed while safe client-error cases continue. See discrepancy register #938.
